details:
ASTRA is a responsive astronaut health monitoring and risk assessment prototype designed for long-duration space missions. The system uses simulated astronaut health inputs such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, and sleep duration to generate an overall health score and classify the astronaut’s condition as Stable, Attention, or Critical.

The dashboard provides a real-time-style health monitoring interface, a human health map, a 7-day health trend visualization, and a recommended next action based on the simulated assessment. Users can change the health inputs and observe how the assessment changes.

The project was developed as a self-contained web application using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, with no external libraries or APIs required for the core application. It is designed to demonstrate how continuous health monitoring and early identification of potential risks could support astronaut safety during long-duration missions.

The project focuses on accessibility, responsive design, clear visualization of health indicators, and an easy-to-understand risk assessment workflow.
